name: Nawaabi Enchiladas
classification_note: New main; tree-nut allergen is a deliberate trade-off to be decided.
cooking_method: Poach/sear tikka-spiced chicken, roll in tortillas, bake in nawaabi sauce

portion.construction: rolled filled tortillas under sauce and cheese, baked

steps: Season and cook chicken to 74 °C; shred.
Soften tortillas in warm oil, fill with chicken and oaxaca, roll.
Sauce, bake until bubbling at 74 °C core; garnish.

plating: Baking dish plated on a board, crema and onion on top.
food_safety: Cook filling to 74 °C (165 °F), probed in the thickest piece.
Raw-protein board/utensils separated; hand-wash; marinate at ≤ 4 °C, discard marinade.
Hot-hold ≥ 57 °C (135 °F) or discard within 2 hours (policy to be set by a food-safety professional).
TREE NUT: cashew sauce; allergen label required.
